import unittest
import stock_deltas as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_signed_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas('delta=-12 delta=4'), [-12, 4])
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas('delta=+3 delta=-7 delta=0'), [3, -7, 0])
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas('delta=-0 delta=+0 delta=001'), [0, 0, 1])
    def test_spacing_and_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas('  delta=-2\n delta=+9\t delta=-11  '), [-2, 9, -11])
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas(''), [])
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas(' \t\n'), [])
        self.assertEqual(app.parse_deltas('delta=-9876543210'), [-9876543210])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
